modal.title: Export this discussion
modal.private_note: The file contains only the posts you can see.
modal.failed: The export could not be created. Please try again.
modal.throttled: You just exported something. Wait a few seconds and try again.

admin.scripts_heading: Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and other scripts in PDFs
admin.scripts_ok: Ready: mPDF is installed, and PDFs of discussions in these scripts are set with it automatically.
admin.scripts_missing: Not set up. PDFs of discussions containing these scripts are refused, and the member is pointed to Word, which shows every language. To enable them, run:
admin.header_help: Printed above the title. You can use {forum}, {title}, {date} and {url}.
admin.footer_help: Printed after the last post. The same placeholders work here.
admin.filename_help: Without the extension. You can use {title}, {id}, {date} and {forum}.
admin.max_posts_help: A longer discussion is cut here, and the file says how many posts were left out.
admin.remote_images_help: Off: only images uploaded to this forum are put in the file, and others become links. On: images linked from other sites are downloaded too, with a 5 MB limit and private network addresses refused.
admin.custom_css_help: Applied to exported PDFs only. It never affects the forum itself.

lib.omitted: {count, plural, one {# more post was} other {# more posts were}} left out because the discussion is longer than this forum exports.

errors.unknown_format: That export format is not available.
errors.needs_mpdf: This discussion contains Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew or another script this forum's PDF export can't set correctly. Export it as Word instead: Word shows every language properly.
